name: WebMCP
description: Exposes a website's own functions as callable tools for browser AI agents via the W3C WebMCP API (navigator/document.modelContext). Ships a polyfill, TypeScript SDK, and React hooks.

skills.name: Tool Registration
skills.description: Registers a website's functions as typed, callable tools via registerTool so browser AI agents can invoke them directly.

skills.name: Browser MCP Transport
skills.description: Bridges in-page tools to MCP clients over an in-browser transport, with no backend MCP server to rebuild.

skills.name: Framework Hooks
skills.description: Provides React hooks and a TypeScript SDK to expose app functionality as WebMCP tools, SSR- and Strict-Mode-safe.
